objective: Complete one evidence-backed physical, semantic, structural, temporal, lineage, coverage, reproducibility, and consumer-impact audit of DWD Base V2 before authorizing the expensive V2.1 reconstruction, then freeze one complete remediation scope so known and discoverable Base defects are corrected in a single successor build window.

hard_gate.reason: The full pre-rebuild audit, findings ledger, remediation scope, and exact semantic digests are not yet accepted.

audit_dimensions.purpose: Prove the exact installed bytes and enumerate every divergence before semantic conclusions are drawn.
required_checks: package id, manifest SHA-256, content digest, and through-date
manifest-declared file size and SHA-256 for every member
cross-mirror byte identity for Hermes, CN01, and OCI

audit_dimensions.purpose: Detect partition-level schema drift and contract mismatches hidden by package-level row counts.
required_checks: every Parquet part schema versus manifest/model contract
decimal precision, timestamp timezone, and enum/domain consistency
partition key values versus physical paths

audit_dimensions.purpose: Audit historical availability at table and field level, not only the row-level knowledge timestamp.
required_checks: knowledge time versus observation, effective, announcement, publication, acquisition, and detection time
field-level future leakage for mutable attributes

audit_dimensions.purpose: Prove stable entity identity and prevent future identity knowledge from leaking into historical joins.
required_checks: stock-code reuse and identifier validity intervals
listing, delisting, relisting, venue, and company lifecycle
identity graph consistency across all dependent tables

audit_dimensions.purpose: Validate every declared relationship at the relevant business and knowledge coordinate.
Detect duplicates, unstable identifiers, overwritten revisions, and events without explicit version identity.
required_checks: late corrections represented as new immutable versions

audit_dimensions.purpose: Detect overlapping, inverted, impossible, or unjustified temporal intervals.
required_checks: non-overlap where the model requires exclusivity
gap classification where continuity is required
effective interval versus listing and calendar bounds

audit_dimensions.purpose: Measure whether the Base covers its declared universe and periods without silent deletion or unsupported inference.
required_checks: expected versus actual security/date and entity/period coordinates
explicit exclusion ledger for every fail-closed row

audit_dimensions.purpose: Detect semantically impossible values that pass schema and checksum verification.
required_checks: OHLC ordering and nonnegative volume/amount constraints
financial fact units, currencies, and concept-value compatibility

audit_dimensions.purpose: Prove every DWD row is traceable only to authorized immutable inputs and accepted derivations.
required_checks: source path and source revision resolvability
builder code revision and policy digest binding
absence of legacy DWS, ADS, release-set, mutable-pointer, or hidden local-state inputs
complete reason-coded lineage for exclusions and corrections

audit_dimensions.purpose: Prove derived tables can be reproduced without hidden current state, environment-dependent ordering, or nondeterministic joins.
required_checks: two independently named reruns over representative real partitions
byte or declared semantic digest equality
no network, mutable database, wall-clock, file-mtime, or ambient-current dependency
reconciliation from exact ODS inputs to DWD outputs

audit_dimensions.purpose: Prevent a correct Base from being paired with incompatible increments or consumers.
required_checks: post-Base Daily lineage and identity compatibility
P4 and other historical PIT consumer field requirements
mirror, restore, deployment, and rollback behavior
explicit migration disposition for every bound consumer and retained artifact

audit_dimensions.purpose: Prove the accepted remediation can be executed once on CN01 without creating a second unsafe migration.
required_checks: partition pilot capacity and memory bounds
NFS assembly and local ingress double verification

execution_phases.name: scope_and_inventory_freeze
execution_phases.exit: Exact package identities, mirrors, 33-table scope, dimensions, commands, code revision, and output paths are frozen.

execution_phases.name: physical_schema_and_partition_audit
execution_phases.exit: All mirrors and every manifest-declared part have integrity and schema dispositions.

execution_phases.name: semantic_identity_temporal_and_lineage_audit
execution_phases.exit: Every table and field family has PIT, identity, relationship, key, interval, and lineage evidence.

execution_phases.name: coverage_numeric_replay_and_consumer_audit
execution_phases.exit: Coverage, domain invariants, real-partition reruns, and downstream compatibility are measured and reason-coded.

execution_phases.name: findings_and_one_time_remediation_freeze
execution_phases.exit: The complete findings ledger and V2.1 remediation scope contain no unknown or unclassified item.

execution_phases.name: human_approval_to_build
execution_phases.exit: Exact audit report, remediation ledger, builder contracts, semantic digests, and CN01 execution plan are approved; only then may the V2.1 builder gate open.
